title: FIFA World Cup 2026 news
overview: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is the 23rd edition of the international football tournament. [1][2][3] France advanced after controlling possession throughout its FIFA World Cup quarter-final. [3] Norway defeated England to stand one win from an unprecedented FIFA World Cup semi-final. [1]

key_findings.text: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is the 23rd edition of the international football tournament.
FIFA confirmed that knockout matches will use the expanded bracket announced for 2026.
Spain named a younger midfield for its next 2026 tournament match.
Norway defeated England to stand one win from an unprecedented FIFA World Cup semi-final.
Host cities added late-night transit for FIFA World Cup supporters.

children.text: Stadium transit plans include 300 late-night buses on World Cup match days.
